The BEAT | June 2025
Overweight European High Yield Credit
TOP IDEAS
The reduction in global growth risks from the recent positive trade negotiation outcomes should reduce default risks, making 
lower-quality credit more attractive. European HY credit appears attractive especially for USD-based investors, given an 
additional 2.4% pick up from hedging euro exposure back to USD.
